learning_outcomes.text: Students should learn the ability to plan and reflect on their own career and incorporate components such as international experience into this planning.
Students can write technical reports and are able to comply with all necessary framework conditions.
To read job advertisements and grasp the essential content in order to make a targeted and successful application.
To write a formally and content-wise correct cover letter/motivation letter for a specific job advertisement.
To write a structured and content-wise correct CV.
To understand international aspects for studying engineering and to analyze them for their own situation.
To analyze one's own personality regarding the personality traits important for the profession.
To conduct a job interview and prepare for it accordingly.
Students acquire fundamental knowledge and skills in scientific work.
They learn to systematically research information, critically evaluate it, and present it in a structured and comprehensible manner in their own work.
They also develop an awareness of scientific integrity, source criticism, and the requirements for academic writing and presenting.
Students expand their knowledge of current topics and developments in engineering sciences with a special focus on sustainability and green technologies.
They gain insights into interdisciplinary research and application fields and reflect on the transfer of scientific findings into practice.
By engaging with different teaching and event formats, they strengthen their ability to analyze and evaluate complex technical questions from various perspectives.
Students get to know current developments and trends in industry and science in the field of mechatronics and vehicle technology.
They can communicate with speakers and their institutes or companies on technical and organizational topics and acquire media literacy through the preparation and design of presentations.

Students are able to understand the presentations and discussions through intensive preparation and follow-up, and to create an introduction and summary based on modern media by analyzing and evaluating the technical content. This ensures a sustainable consolidation of the conveyed knowledge.

syllabus_topics: Possibilities of financing international internships/semesters abroad
Career planning
Internationalization – exchange of experiences and reports from students about stays abroad
Fundamentals of personality analysis, actual state analysis
Searching for job offers
Criteria for selecting companies and activities
Formal aspects of the application (cover letter, CV, photo…)
Preparation for job interviews
Practical exercise
Introduction to time and project management
Scientific basic techniques: Researching, Reading, Organizing, Citing
Scientific illustrations
Formal structure of scientific papers
Publishing scientific articles
Electronic publishing
Patents
Career planning
Scientific presenting: Preparation, elaboration, presentation
Culture and ethics of scientific publishing
Current and relevant topics from various areas of engineering sciences, with strong reference to sustainability and green technologies.
Interdisciplinary perspective and insights into diverse application fields of engineering expertise.
Latest state of mechatronic and vehicle technological systems and processes from development to finished product
Connection between industry and university
Handling new media through a hybrid format
Working methods and company culture of involved companies
Research, development and new technologies in the various specialized fields of engineering sciences
Design, development, and simulation tools
teaching_methods: Kolloquium with speakers from industry and science

assessment_methods.method: Ungraded academic achievement (oral exam, presentation, or portfolio) for MECB511
Ungraded academic achievement (oral exam, presentation, or portfolio) for MECB512
Ungraded academic achievement (oral exam, presentation, or portfolio) for MECB513
Ungraded academic achievement (oral exam, presentation, or portfolio) for MECB514

assessment_rules: The assessment for MECB511, MECB512, MECB513, and MECB514 are unweighted study achievements (unbenotete Studienleistung) which can be an oral exam, a presentation (Referat), or a portfolio, as announced by the lecturers. All parts are mandatory for successful completion.
